critique_summary: Found 10 issues (3 medium, 7 low severity). All issues have been fixed in spec.md. Main improvements: (1) Added Edge Runtime limitations for middleware, (2) Documented feature flag API functions with code examples, (3) Added rate limiting recommendation, (4) Clarified RBAC role vs permission distinction, (5) Fixed function naming consistency, (6) Added SECURITY DEFINER guidance, (7) Enhanced Tailwind 4.x guidance, (8) Added more edge cases, (9-10) Enhanced DON'T section with critical prohibitions.
